People: Victor Hugo (author, Wikidata Q535), died 1885; François Flameng (illustrator, Wikidata Q977953), died 1923. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Hugo, Victor, 1802-1885; Flameng, François, 1856-1923 [Illustrator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Notre-Dame de Paris. Tome 1 / par Victor Hugo, C. Gosselin (Paris), 1831, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bnf-bpt6k6497134z. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 64%, 39%, 67% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of François Flameng, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
